name: B10-0386/2025 (PPE) – Case of Abdoul Aziz Goma, arbitrarily detained in Togo
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Abdoul Aziz Goma, arbitrarily detained in Togo
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is making a public appeal to the authorities in Togo. It asks them to free Abdoul-Aziz Goma, an Irish-Togolese man held since 2018 after helping peaceful protesters. It says his detention is arbitrary, that he was tortured, and that his trial was unfair. It also asks the European Union to push diplomatically for his release and to consider penalties against Togolese officials responsible.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament only calls for Goma's release, prison reform and possible EU penalties.
- **Who it affects:** Goma, Togolese officials, and EU diplomats dealing with Togo.
- **What happens next:** The resolution goes to EU bodies, Irish and Togolese authorities, and African and UN organisations.
